name: Deleverage-rally fade (1h short, perp-spot basis confirms cover-driven)
rationale: MECHANISM (H2 with a basis confirmation, replacing the ADX arm): when a pop is short-covering rather than fresh leverage, the perp-spot basis does NOT expand the way a leveraged-longs breakout would — a rising price on falling OI with a flat/soft basis is the cleanest fingerprint of a participation-less rally. The counterparty is the short-coverer whose bid extinguishes itself. Run as a perp SHORT. Entry: open_interest cross_down (contracting) AND ret_Nd above a positive floor (rising) AND rsi above an overbought floor AND perp_spot_basis below a ceiling (no leveraged-long premium building — cover-driven, not conviction). DISCONFIRMER: replace OI-down with OI-UP — no flip to losing means the divergence is irrelevant; and drop the basis arm — if it does not degrade, basis added no separation and this is generic overbought-short. Net of fees the fade must clear, and it must not overlap H1's profitable windows.
catalyst: OI contracting + overbought pop + soft basis — a cover-driven, non-leveraged rally to fade
